title: 2026 CIF Central Section football playoffs: Bracket matchups for Kern County, Bakersfield area schools - NewsBreak
text:
By Jose Franco ,
7 hours ago
BAKERSFIELD, Calif. (KGET) -- The high school football regular season has come to an end, and now the games mean even more -- it's one and done.
Twenty two schools from Kern County are in this year's playoffs brackets. Bakersfield is in the top division -- I-AA. Garces Memorial, Liberty and Bakersfield Christian are all in Division I-A which could potentially result in an all-Bakersfield title game.
Below are the full matchups for the opening rounds of the 2026 CIF Central Section football playoffs.
Division I-AA -- Quarterfinals
(4) Bakersfield vs. (5) Clovis
(3) St. Joseph vs. (6) Clovis West
(1) Central East, (2) Buchanan get byes in the semifinals
Division I-A -- Quarterfinals
(1) Garces Memorial vs. (8) Clovis North
(4) Liberty vs. (5) Tulare Union
(3) Hanford vs. (6) Sanger
(2) Bakersfield Christian vs. (7) Clovis East
Division II -- First Round
(8) Lemoore vs. (9) Centennial
(5) Central Valley Christian vs. (12) San Joaquin Memorial
(4) Kingsburg vs. (13) Golden West
(3) Redwood vs. (14) Bullard
(6) Arroyo Grande vs. (11) Edison
(7) San Luis Obispo vs. (10) Dinuba
(2) Tulare Western vs. (15) Justin Garza
(1) Independence gets bye into quarterfinals
Division III -- First Round
(8) Highland vs. (9) Washington Union

(3) Nipomo vs. (14) Righetti

(1) Shafter, (2) Immanuel get byes into the quarterfinals

Division V -- First Round

(6) Chavez vs. (11) Bishop Union
(7) East Bakersfield vs. (10) Firebaugh
(2) Selma vs. (15) Cabrillo
